remarks: Welcome to Heights Crossing, Darien's premier luxury apartment community offering upscale living with unmatched convenience. Located directly across from the Metro North station, this newly constructed development offers effortless access to NYC while nestled in a vibrant coastal town. This 1-bedroom, 1-bath residence features an open-concept layout with wood-style luxury vinyl tile flooring, abundant natural light, and accessible pathways. The chef-inspired kitchen includes ADA-compliant lowered Quartz countertops, a bar-height island, GE appliances, custom cabinetry, a designer backsplash, and lowered surfaces for ease of use. A pantry and stacked in-unit washer/dryer add everyday convenience. The spacious bedroom includes a large walk-in closet and an adjacent full bath with a zero-threshold walk-in shower. The secure-access building offers garage parking with accessible spaces conveniently located near elevator access, on-site staffing, a fitness and wellness center with golf simulator, co-working spaces, fireside lounge, event space, bike storage, trash chutes in hallways, and a package/mail room. A tranquil courtyard, nearby beaches, parks, shops, and dining complete the experience.
